long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The lamp belongs on the desk where I can see it, and a desk is where things get kept.
There is clay at the bank and I have decided to make something of it.
I will take a piece of clay with empty paws and bring it home to keep.
The workbench is where things get shaped, and I want to try shaping the clay.
I will shape the clay into something worth keeping, which is my long goal.
My energy is running low and a patch of sun is the right place to recover it.

today.reason: I will tidy the lamp away, bring clay home and try shaping it, then sleep in the sun before the evening.
